versions.short: The bill would require federal courts to issue a no-contact order, which bars the defendant from contacting the victim, when a person is convicted of a felony that involves violence or a sexual act or sexual conduct. The order would be requested by the victim or the federal government and would be imposed at sentencing. It would generally remain in effect for the defendant's lifetime unless it is ended or paused under set procedures. Victims would not be charged any fee for obtaining such an order.
